name: Site Visits - Registration and management
description: Verifies site visit management: registering visits, attaching findings, linking to work requests

planSteps.description: Assert that site visits list loads with date, client, technician, and purpose columns
Click 'New Site Visit' and fill in: client, date, location, purpose, technician assigned
Add visit findings: observations, photos, recommendations
Link the site visit to an existing work request if applicable
Submit and verify the visit is recorded with 'completed' status
Verify the site visit detail shows all entered data with the option to generate a visit report
